entityDescription:
Blue Orbit Space Systems is a company focused on the space and plasma technology sector, dedicated to research and development of advanced propulsion systems and related technologies. Founded in 2022 by a multidisciplinary team of highly skilled and passionate scientific and engineering professionals, Blue Orbit aims to become a leader in the field of space propulsion and space exploration.
This leadership within the space industry will be achieved through the unique expertise brought in by each of the founders. Firstly, future Dr. Rene Cartaya Lopez, a Physics graduate specializing in plasma process chemistry and passionate about space technology. Secondly, Engineer Ahymerd Riveras, specializing in production and telecommunications, with a keen interest in system optimization and efficiency. Thirdly, Dr. Abraham Vivas Borda, a mechanical engineer with a PhD in renewable energies, devoted to realizing a sustainable vision for the future of space. Fourthly, MSc. Felix Konefka, a specialist in plasma physics, a generator of innovation in the space sector. Lastly, Engineer Marco Cen Puc, a mechatronics specialist, enthusiastic about system automation.
Our focus is on developing advanced propulsion technologies that drive space exploration in a more efficient and sustainable manner. We work closely with space agencies, academic institutions, and private companies to promote innovation and take our solutions to the next level. Moreover, our commitment to excellence extends not only to science and engineering but also to the customer experience, providing personalized solutions and exceptional service. We strive to understand each customers unique needs and deliver tailor-made solutions that propel their success and help them reach new heights in space exploration.
Our primary goal is to turn bold ideas into tangible realities and contribute to scientific and technological advancement on a global scale. Challenging ourselves every day to push the boundaries of what is possible and forge new paths towards the stars.
In addition to our endeavors in space, Blue Orbit is also exploring terrestrial applications of plasma technology. Among these applications are: seed treatment through cold plasma exposure, where we can stimulate growth, increase resistance to diseases and pests, and improve overall performance. Activated Plasma Water, through the use of cutting-edge technologies, we develop systems that activate water at a molecular level, enhancing its quality and properties. This activated water has applications in various fields such as agriculture, health, and industry. Lastly, leveraging the properties of plasma, we develop innovative processes to decompose and transform waste materials, thus contributing to reducing environmental impact and promoting a circular economy.
In summary, at Blue Orbit, we are passionate about space and believe in the power of technology to drive human progress both in space and on Earth. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and leadership in the space industry. Join us on this exciting adventure towards an interplanetary future and discover how we are transforming the space landscape to pave the way for humanity to reach the stars.

entityDescription:
Our company is advancing industrial-grade EEG technology through early-stage, proof-of-concept solutions designed to meet the unique demands of high-stakes environments, including space missions, maritime operations, and industrial transport. Currently at Technology Readiness Level (TRL) 3, we are focused on developing and validating proprietary artifact deletion algorithms alongside rugged, adaptable EEG hardware tailored for extreme conditions where conventional EEG devices cannot operate effectively.
At this stage, our core R&D efforts center on refining our artifact correction technology, a key component of our intellectual property (IP) strategy, to ensure high-fidelity, real-time brain monitoring in challenging industrial contexts. This includes testing our algorithms in simulated environments to validate their effectiveness in filtering out environmental noise and physiological artifacts—an essential requirement for safety-critical applications.
Our collaborations with hardware manufacturers and research institutions support this validation process, allowing us to co-develop prototypes that can withstand the operational demands of industrial and remote settings. Additionally, we are building partnerships with OEMs and industry stakeholders in health tech, focusing on IP licensing and modular integration options for future commercial deployment.
At TRL 3, we are laying the groundwork for patentable IP and proof-of-concept demonstrations that will underpin our transition to field-ready EEG solutions. Our mission is to create technology that not only elevates safety standards in critical industries but also enables accurate, non-invasive neurological monitoring where it has never been possible before. As we progress, we aim to secure additional research funding and partnerships that will support our journey toward scalable, compliant EEG solutions designed for the most demanding environments.

entityDescription:
Natsionalna Elektricheska Kompania EAD (NEK EAD) was incorporated in late 1991 and over the years it has established its position in the power industry and the economy of the Republic of Bulgaria. The mission of NEK EAD is to provide safe, efficient and uninterrupted power supply. NEK EAD is a sole-owner joint-stock company. Since 2008 the capital of NEK is held by Bulgarian Energy Holding EAD. The main businesses of NEK EAD include electricity generation and trading. The Company is managed by a three-member Board of Directors.

NEK EAD operates one of the largest dams and hydropower schemes in the country, applying stringent requirements on their O&M safety and efficiency. The Company lies at the heart of the electric power system of Bulgaria, producing electricity at 31 hydro-power and pumped storage hydro-power plants, with a total installed generating capacity of 2737 MW and pumping capacity of 931 MW. The flexible generation facilities of the company have a key role in ensuring security of supply and reliability and security of the grid system of Bulgaria. The total capacity of the dam reservoirs operated by NEK EAD represents 55% of the total controlled water resources in the Republic of Bulgaria.

Licenses issued to NEK EAD by the Energy and Water Regulatory Commission:
- Hydro (HPP&PS) generation license;
- Public power supply license expanded to include the rights and obligations of a "Special Balancing Group Coordinator".
- Electricity trading license expanded to include the rights and obligations of a "Standard Balancing Group Coordinator".
- Supplier of Last Resort license expanded to include the rights and obligations of a "Special Balancing Group Coordinator".

HonuWorx is a remote robotics company based in Aberdeen, Scotland. HonuWorx was founded in 2020 to replace legacy offshore support vessels with subsea deployment platforms and move robotics operators to the safety of shore. By lowering the cost and carbon footprint of subsea inspection, maintenance and repair (IMR) work, our technology supports the profitable and sustainable growth of the offshore energy sector.
HonuWorx has developed a superior, patented approach to performing work underwater at scale. It upends the unit economics of legacy approaches by replacing large, polluting, diesel powered vessels with a unique all-electric, remotely controlled uncrewed subsea inspection and intervention system. “Loggerhead” sets industry standards in safety, reliability and efficiency.
HonuWorx is ready to build a $billion subsea services company, targeting a market share of 20% and over $500m in revenue in under 10 years. Honuworx is able to replace large elements of the demand for ROV based subsea inspection and intervention currently served by large public companies such as Oceaneering, Subsea 7 and Fugro.

entityName: Hochschule für Technik und Wirtschaft Dresden
entityDescription:
With around 4,800 students, the Dresden University of Applied Sciences (HTW Dresden) is the second largest university in the state capital of Saxony, Germany. Founded in 1992, it is now one of the top German universities of applied sciences. It offers more than 40 degree courses in the fields of civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science, economics, geoinformatics, agriculture, environment, chemistry and design which lead to Bachelor's, Master's and Diplom degrees.

Teaching and research are closely linked at HTW Dresden and are strongly practice-oriented. Students can participate in research projects at an early stage, benefit from close contacts with industrial partners and also have the opportunity to do a doctorate as part of a cooperative doctoral program.

Research at HTW Dresden is primarily oriented towards the three interdisciplinary profile lines: Securing Natural Resources, Developing Sustainable Mobility and Infrastructure, and Designing, Networking and Digitalizing the Economy and Work. With its application-oriented research, the university is an important partner, especially for SMEs in Saxony, and is very well networked with the numerous technology and research centers in Dresden as a science location.

The University of Applied Sciences supports start-ups from the university environment in the development and implementation of innovative business ideas and arranges contacts with cooperation partners in business and industry. In addition to excellent study conditions and a first-class education, students in Dresden can expect an environment with a high quality of life, art and culture, great leisure activities and a beautiful landscape.The degrees obtained at HTW Dresden are highly recognized by companies as well as research and educational institutions. This is proven not only by current studies and university rankings, but above all by the successful placement of the graduates in practice.

Viridian is a highly technical micro-company specialising in the advanced modelling, design and quantification of Nature-based Solutions. We have developed HydroloGIS: a truly unique method for identifying the most effective, natural solutions to a host of water problems - such as flooding, drought or river pollution - then ranking all alternative option for how much impact they will have on local problems. It blends scientific rigour with commercial pragmatism during the advanced, mathematical modelling of ecosystem services.
To this we integrate a whole spectrum of more standard benefits, such as carbon sequestration and biodiversity, so that stakeholders have all the technical advice they need to decide on the best course of action in their community or region – all while meeting project objectives. 
This human-centric, participatory design helps stakeholders 'own' solutions, so we rapidly build consensus and make the whole process quick, inexpensive and successful. The benefit/cost ration of using HydroloGIS can be well over 50, since it reduces the cost of achieving projects whilst improving their outcomes.

TÜViT SeCom, based in Berlin, was founded in 2018. The object of the business is the provision of services and consulting for ICT networks and digital applications with a focus on IT security. In particular, consulting with regard to planning, modernization, consolidation and further development of IT infrastructures, IT services as well as security technologies in the context of digital transformation are services that we provide for our customers. The main Focus topics are:
· Analysis, design and optimization of ICT network infrastructures
· Consulting services for complex ICT networks with special security requirements
· Project management for ICT network infrastructure projects
· Preparation and support of ISMS implementation according to BSI IT-Basic Protection in accordance with 100-X / 200-X as well as ISO/IEC 27001
· Preparation for the verification according to §8a BSIG (KRITIS)
· Consulting on data protection according to EU-DSGVO
· Consulting for the preparation of audits and certifications
· Networking strategies & conception
· Digitalization of business processes

entityDescription:
Code Runners is a software development company specializing in custom software development, data engineering, data analytics and machine learning. The company works as both a subcontractor for software development and also provides own software products and services to customers. The three main vertical in which the company operates are market intelligence, healthcare and information security.

At the end of FY 2022 Code Runners was split in three different legal entities focused on providing different services and products.

After the operation Code Runners has remained focused on data engineering, data analytics and data science activities.
A second legal entity MA Consulting LTD (BG206690955) has been focused on custom software development and software consultancy.
A third legal entity Bio Labs LTD (BG204054054) has been focused on providing software and data analytics services for medical device manufacturing companies.

This split of activities in the reason for the reduced turnover in the main entity Code Runners after the end of FY 2023. The company is operational, has employe staff and in good standing. We have attached a certificate issued by the Bulgarian commercial register.

entityDescription:
Spolek přátel gymnázia Slaný dedicated to fostering a strong community of parents, friends, supporters, and sponsors with the aim of safeguarding and promoting the interests of students of Gymnázium Slaný. The institution strives to provide material and financial support to enhance educational and developmental activities while also fostering collaboration with other schools, both domestically and internationally.
We support students' educational, cultural, scientific, public outreach, sports, publishing, experiential, international, and other enriching activities. Efforts are focused on improving the school’s resources, modernizing its teaching methods and facilities, and supporting public-benefit initiatives in education, culture, and sports.

For extracurricular activities and informal education, regular clubs are organized, including robotics, Laborky.cz, and Zkoumálek. entityDescription: Okala provides software and consultancy services to support large-scale environmental measurement and reporting. Its technological solutions include mobile phone apps that guide data collection in the field, AI processing tools that rapidly generate high-quality datasets, and an online platform through which biodiversity insights can be integrated and visualised. Since 2022, the company has delivered projects for a range of entities, including multinational corporations, the industrial and agricultural sectors, conservation organisations, academic research groups, and private landowners. Globally, Okala’s services have been implemented across more than 2 million hectares of land.
